urn:eigenius:core:description: Chemical-reaction-network institution backed by Catalyst.jl. v1 scope: validates `ConservationLaw` claims by re-running `Catalyst.conservationlaws(rn)` on the network and row-span-checking the claimed coefficient vector. Future scope (D27 §4.4): SteadyState validation, deficiency claims, the Catalyst → DiffEq comorphism for ODE compilation, the Catalyst → Symbolics comorphism via ModelingToolkit.

Julia entry point that takes a `ConservationLaw` mirror struct and returns a `Verdict`. The handler parses the claim's network source via `Core.eval` of `@reaction_network`, computes the conservation matrix via `Catalyst.conservationlaws(rn)`, and checks the claimed coefficient vector lies in the row span. `Holds` on a verified linear invariant; `Fails` on a refuted one (no Undecidable — conservation-law validity is a structural-rank question, not a heuristic).

AutoOnLoad gate fired against every newly committed `ConservationLaw` resource. Verdict shape is the canonical D14 tri-state, but for this institution `Holds` and `Fails` are the only outcomes the handler produces — `Undecidable` is reserved for future cases (e.g. a structural-simplification path that can't decide degenerate networks). A `Fails` verdict rejects the gated commit per D31 §6.3 and lands a `Verdict + RuntimeInvocation` audit anchor explaining the rejection.

Julia entry point for the `qc_cat_to_ode` OnDemand QueryClass + the operational backing of the `Catalyst → DiffEq` comorphism. Takes a `CatalystToOdeInput` (network + ICs + parameters + tspan) and returns an `OdeProblem` whose RHS is a list of FormulaTerm-typed `RhsComponent`s — the Nth component is the symbolic time-derivative of the Nth species in `network.species_declared`. Internally: parses the @reaction_network source, computes `netstoichmat(rn) * oderatelaw.(reactions(rn))` to get the symbolic RHS expressions, translates each to FormulaTerm via `num_to_formula` (D32 §6 — same SymbolicUtils-walking translator the Symbolics handler uses).

OnDemand QueryClass: given a `CatalystToOdeInput(network, ics, params, tspan)`, compile to a chain-typed `OdeProblem` with FormulaTerm RHS. Dispatched explicitly via EigenQL FIBER (D2 v2 §3.5). The operational backing for the `Catalyst → DiffEq` comorphism — the typed Comorphism resource at `julia/comorphisms/catalyst-to-diffeq.eigon.json` is the declarative contract; this QueryClass is what users call today (until D14's M5 evaluator wires up the four-step extract→m→reify pipeline as a single FIBER param coercion).

Typed outbound view of `CatalystToOdeInput`: extracts a chain-typed `OdeProblem` with FormulaTerm RHS via `compile_to_ode`. Source side of the `Catalyst → DiffEq` Comorphism (D27 §4.4.4 / D32 §6.2 generalised). The payload type is `OdeProblem` because both ends of the comorphism speak the same shape — the typed middle is the identity Lambda. Anchored on the `compile_to_ode` Julia handler.
